---
title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---

@fig-runtime-rating shows relationship between movie runtime in minutes and the IMDB rating. 

::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"],films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDB Rating")
plt.show()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display}
![Movie runtime in minutes versus IMDB rating. This association is more nuanced and random-looking.](runtime-rating_files/figure-html/fig-runtime-rating-output-1.png){#fig-runtime-rating width=590 height=431}
:::
:::

